# Lab vendor index

Third-party files the Lab page loads with `<script>` tags (no CDN at runtime). From the npm tarball of **three@0.147.0** (`npm pack three@0.147.0`, tarball sha1 `1974af9e8e0c1efb3a8561334d57c0b6c29a7951`), copied unchanged.

- `three.min.js` — `build/three.min.js` (r147, UMD build: defines the global `THREE`).
- `OrbitControls.js` — `examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js` (classic script: defines `THREE.OrbitControls`; the `examples/js` folder was dropped in later releases).
- `three-LICENSE` — The three.js MIT licence (`LICENSE` from the tarball).
- `index.md` — Index of this folder.
